title: Hedgehog Hop
blurb: Jump the logs, munch the apples. How far can you go?
explain: Section 1 · Settings
Values like GRAVITY and JUMP are read from the web address. That is how Remix works: change the numbers, the game changes.
Section 4 · Controls
jump() only works when onGround is true. That rule stops the hedgehog jumping in mid-air.
Section 5 · Gravity
Every frame, gravity is added to the speed (hog.vy += GRAVITY). A jump sets the speed negative, so the hedgehog goes up, slows and falls.
Section 5 · Collisions
The game checks whether the hedgehog's box overlaps a log's box. If it does, the game is over.
Section 7 · Game loop
requestAnimationFrame runs update then draw about 60 times a second. Every game has a loop like this.

title: Star Catcher
blurb: Catch the falling stars and dodge the space rocks.

params.label: Lives
params.hint: How many rocks you can survive

explain: Section 1 · Settings
FALL_SPEED, BASKET_WIDTH and ROCK_CHANCE control difficulty. Game designers call this balancing.
Section 4 · Two kinds of control
Keyboard and pointer controls both move the same basket.x, so the game works on laptops and phones.
Section 5 · Randomness
Math.random() < ROCK_CHANCE decides if a new object is a rock. With 0.25, about one in four is a rock.
Section 5 · Catching
An object is caught when it is level with the basket AND within half the basket's width of its centre.
Section 6 · Drawing a star
star() joins ten points, alternating long and short, to make a five-pointed star.
